answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a primary Sybil barrier by requiring capital bonds. Like a lotus blooming from capital, this mechanism mandates that identity weight correlates to asset ownership. A falcon agent validating consensus must lock tokens, ensuring any attempt to create a massive fake network in a digital meadow incurs linear or exponential costs equal to the total stake, effectively bankrupting an attacker who tries to dilute the network through sybil proliferation.
